title: Backlog prioritization scoring
description: Scores candidate work using configurable RICE, ICE, or weighted criteria and produces a ranked backlog.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: backlog-prioritization-scoring
  title: Backlog prioritization scoring
  description: Scores candidate work using configurable RICE, ICE, or weighted criteria and produces a ranked backlog.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Create a transparent and reviewable priority order.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - portfolio-owner
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Backlog and scoring model
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - items
          - model
          - weights
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: estimate
      kind: agent
      name: Estimate scoring inputs
      role: Product portfolio analyst
      prompt: Estimate each scoring factor with ranges, evidence, confidence, and stated assumptions.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: score
      name: Calculate weighted scores
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      role: Portfolio scoring analyst
      prompt: Calculate the selected RICE, ICE, or weighted score exactly as configured. Preserve ranges, confidence,
        evidence, and assumptions for every factor.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
    - id: challenge
      kind: agent
      name: Challenge outliers
      role: Independent reviewer
      prompt: Review unusually high, low, or low-confidence scores. Flag unsupported assumptions and propose corrections.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: rank
      name: Rank and segment backlog
      kind: transform
      config:
        operation: sort
    - id: portfolio-owner
      kind: approval
      name: Portfolio owner approves ranking
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Prioritized backlog and scoring rationale
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: estimate
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: estimate
      to: score
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: score
      to: challenge
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: challenge
      to: rank
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: score
      to: rank
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: rank
      to: portfolio-owner
      kind: dependency
    - id: e7
      from: portfolio-owner
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
